# cout-cache

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-w46-ai-token-budgets-range" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-w46/ai-token-budgets-range/" data-aixpm-date="2026-11-10" data-aixpm-title="AI token budgets range from $25 a month to more than $10,000." markdown>

**AI token budgets range from $25 a month to more than $10,000.** A consultant spending nearly $100 a day on Claude saw the firm's standard allocation cut to $200 a month. Replies give a rough benchmark: $25 a month ($75 if billable) at one firm, $10,000 a month plus unlimited on-premise at another, "10-13k/month" at an MBB firm. One proposal: charge usage above a $200–400 baseline to a business unit or project code. Anonymous, unverifiable figures. [Reddit r/consulting, 6 Nov 2026](https://www.reddit.com/r/consulting/comments/1xokfdc/whats_everyones_token_limit/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-10-award-winning-workflow-cost" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-10/award-winning-workflow-cost/" data-aixpm-date="2026-10-31" data-aixpm-title="An award-winning AI workflow cost $12–14 per file against about 80 cents done manually." markdown>

**An award-winning AI workflow cost $12–14 per file against about 80 cents done manually.** An audit at an unnamed mid-sized enterprise found the 90% faster turnaround hid the bill: pilot costs sat in a central innovation fund, and roughly 40% of daily transactions fell into a human exception queue taking ten minutes each, twice the manual baseline. [CIO.com, 8 Oct 2026](https://www.cio.com/article/4232005/i-audited-an-award-winning-ai-project-the-case-study-left-out-the-cloud-bill.html)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-08-cisco-agent-90000-employees" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-08/cisco-agent-90000-employees/" data-aixpm-date="2026-08-31" data-aixpm-title="Cisco is giving all 90,000 employees an AI agent, designed around token cost." markdown>

**Cisco is giving all 90,000 employees an AI agent, designed around token cost.** The rollout started with the new fiscal year at the end of July. CFO Mark Patterson says the system routes each request to the most efficient model ("It's not going to burn a whole bunch of tokens with frontier models"), runs largely on-premises, and that AI already writes 80–90% of the first draft of the MD&A in financial filings. Cisco does not disclose the cost. [Fortune, 1 Jul 2026](https://fortune.com/2026/07/01/cisco-cfo-ai-agents-finance-employees-mark-patterson/)
